title: 3回生顔合わせ｜立命館大学 社会知能研究室

summary.lead: We had a face-to-face meeting with our third-year students!

overview: During the lunch break, we had a meet-and-greet lunch with the third-year students!The assignment to the research lab was decided recently, and this was the first meeting.The Social Intelligence Research Laboratory holds meetings in a style where third-year students prepare self-introduction materials in advance three times a year and ask each other questions to get to know each other better.This time, we brought Mister Donut and snacks or juice and enjoyed lunch in a friendly atmosphere.The third-year students seemed nervous about meeting for the first time, but as they spent enjoyable moments with their seniors, it appeared that their tension gradually eased.I'm looking forward to the upcoming lab life!
